semantics.input_definition: sum of the two actual actuator_force values in N m; not per-wheel
semantics.ID_input_source: sum(snapshots[-1].applied_ctrl_nm) after the two physics steps; SimSnapshot reads data.actuator_force
semantics.normalization: per-state RMS/scales; aggregate=sqrt(mean((residual/scales)^2)); scales frozen from training RMS (not std)

fit.equation: Y=x_GT[k+1], Z=[x_GT[k],actual two-wheel torque SUM]; Y=Z@[A B].T

reference_lifecycle.completion_semantics: T_v is S-curve completion; T_full is the first feasible nominal horizon; existing FF fade starts at T_full
reference_lifecycle.preload: none; e_p and p_ref are not changed
reference_lifecycle.lean_completion: solver-constrained zero-lean/zero-rate endpoint at first feasible T_full; never the next command time

horizon_search.threshold_basis: V1 engineering threshold, not a theoretical feasibility theorem

reference_lifecycle.feedforward_exit_input: last solved nominal interval input; no cruise nominal solve

FF_FB_cancellation.definition: 1 - mean(abs(u_total)) / mean(abs(u_ff_used) + abs(u_fb)); larger means more opposing cancellation

closed_loop.history_units: seconds, meters, m/s, radians, rad/s, summed N*m; all theta fields are errors relative to theta_eq, not absolute angles
closed_loop.scope: new A/B nominal solver/feedforward ONLY; original K4 and all other settings frozen

predeclared_closed_loop_gate.clear_improvement_definition: on EACH existing +/-0.6 arm: new aggregate normalized RMS <= 0.8 * corrected-old, and both v/rate RMS strictly lower
predeclared_closed_loop_gate.threshold_basis: engineering interpretation of clearly better; declared before fitting, not a theoretical guarantee
